name: Humantic AI
label: Humantic AI — personality profiles
description: Official Humantic AI Data API v1.0. GET https://api.humantic.ai/v1/user-profile/create and GET https://api.humantic.ai/v1/user-profile/. Auth is query param apikey. create_profile id is a LinkedIn profile URL or email (official GET). get_profile uses the same id after 30–45s. Personality profiling: customer must have a lawful basis and notice; no covert HR screening. Docs: https://api.humantic.ai/.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Official query fields. id is required (LinkedIn URL, email, or the unique id used at create). Do not put apikey here. Example: {"id":"https://www.linkedin.com/in/example/","persona":"sales"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: create_profile | get_profile.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Official id query param. Create GET: LinkedIn profile URL or email. Fetch: the same id. Do not use values starting with 'test' (reserved). Document/text POST (multipart document/text) is official but not sent by OfficialApiNode JSON — use GET create for URL/email.

schema.label: firstname
schema.description: Optional. Helps email-id resolution on create.

schema.label: lastname
schema.description: Optional. Helps email-id resolution on create.

schema.label: persona
schema.description: Fetch persona. EXACT: sales | hiring. Comma-separated if both.

schema.label: stateless
schema.description: Create: true to ask Humantic not to save text/document input. Query string true/false.

schema.label: analysistype
schema.description: Create: talent for English resume/hiring text. Omit otherwise.

schema.label: web_insights
schema.description: true to request public-web insights when the key is authorized. Do not send the deprecated external_signals alias (sunset 2026-06-30).

schema.label: override
schema.description: Fetch: true to return results below 50% confidence (inaccurate). Use only with care.

schema.label: source
schema.description: Query-string parameter `source` for operations: create_profile, get_profile.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (personality_analysis, persona, metadata). Fetch may be IN_PROGRESS — retry after 15s. Do not log DISC/Big Five scores as they are personal data. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: Humantic apikey query parameter (official name). StudioQuack secret. Never on INPUT. Never logged. Dashboard: https://api.humantic.ai/

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: HTTP timeout. Default 45. Floor 1. Fetch after LinkedIn/email create is often 30–45s until COMPLETE.
